'''Ecruteak City''' can be accessed from the East by [[Route 42]] and from the South by [[Route 37]].

This city contains Ecruteak City's Gym, with Morty as its leader.

The player can access the [[Burned Tower]] in the North-West corner of the city, but the access to the [[Bell Tower]] is blocked by a Monk until shown both the Light and Dark Stones.
